summary: Refresh the published attention list when a harness is blocked on a person and when that prompt clears

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Attention rows are unchanged; the published list only refreshes on more claims.

recovery.detail: Only when the in-memory published attention list refreshes changes; reverting restores the previous refresh rules.
